reason: I'd want to see a real shop and a real warranty before handing anyone SAR 1,300 or more for film on my M4. The money being held is good, but I still have to trust that the film is genuine and that the partner will honour the warranty when something goes wrong.
objection: How do I know the film is genuine and the warranty is honoured, and that a partner who just joined the app will still be around in two years?
would_change_my_mind: A verified partner with a known physical shop I can visit, who shows the film brand and a warranty I can claim directly at that shop.
